name: Happy House
summary: Happy House is set in a world where internet-famous animals are the creators of their own adorable viral content. The series follows a crew of teen animal content creators as they navigate friendships, rivalries and awkward crushes, all while juggling the pressures of being teens in the digital age.

name: MTV Russia Music Awards
summary: The MTV Russia Music Awards (RMA) features local and international acts and music celebrities being honoured by Russian viewers.

name: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
summary:
Serial killer. Grave robber. Psycho. In the frozen fields of 1950s rural Wisconsin, a friendly, mild-mannered recluse named Eddie Gein lived quietly on a decaying farm – hiding a house of horrors so gruesome it would redefine the American nightmare. Driven by isolation, psychosis, and an all-consuming obsession with his mother, Gein's perverse crimes birthed a new kind of monster that would haunt Hollywood for decades. From Psycho to The Texas Chainsaw Massacre to The Silence of the Lambs, Gein's macabre legacy gave birth to fictional monsters born in his image and ignited a cultural obsession with the criminally deviant. Ed Gein didn't just influence a genre -- he became the blueprint for modern horror.

Ryan Murphy and Ian Brennan's groundbreaking anthology series returns with its third, most harrowing installment yet. Monster: The Ed Gein Story tells the story of how one simple man in Plainfield, Wisconsin became history's most singular ghoul. He revealed to the world the most horrific truth of all -- that monsters aren't born, they're made...by us.

name: I Happened To Join A Group Of Cool Guys On A School Trip
summary: Hoki, a second-year high school student, is separated from his close friends and left alone during the group assignments for the trip. However, a guy from his middle school days invites him into a group of four popular, good-looking guys, almost forcibly. Initially, Hoki feels out of place among these so-called "Big Four", the school's most admired boys. But one of them, Watarai, starts paying attention to Hoki, and little by little, they begin to open up to each other…

name: PUNKS△TRIANGLE
summary:
Fashion student Chiaki dreams of seeing his designs on the runway, worn by none other than Ai—the charismatic male model who changed his life. When a prestigious competition promises to make that dream come true, Chiaki is fired up to win. But his hopes are dashed when he's paired with the clumsy and unfashionable Enaga for the project. One fateful night, after a run-in with some delinquents, Chiaki is unexpectedly saved by his idol Ai. Even more shocking, Ai seductively offers to teach him how to have fun at night…

Caught between the alluring, mysterious model he worships and a clumsy, rough-around-the-edges classmate who can't seem to stay out of trouble (but may be hiding a surprising secret), Chiaki faces a heart-pounding, pure boy's love dilemma that will turn his world upside down!

previousepisode.name: Teach Me How to Kiss, Too

name: Ahora que no Estás
summary: Javi, a young widower, finds a letter from his beloved wife, Mia, in which she leaves him a list of women he must meet to find love again.

name: ODB: Wu-Tang Forever
summary: The story of Ol' Dirty Bastard, co-founder of legendary hip-hop group the Wu-Tang Clan, through the eyes of his friends, family, and collaborators.

name: Slangedræber
summary: When a female informant is killed, maverick cop Brian and fellow rogue officers from Uropatruljen battle a crime syndicate, using extreme methods that often cross legal boundaries.

name: Rise of the Dictators
summary:
Dictator, despot, authoritarian or strong man, whatever you call them they all have one thing in common – the pursuit of absolute power. ‘Rise of the Dictators' is the story of the Führer, Adolf Hitler; il Duce, Benito Mussolini and the Vozhd Josef Stalin. How did these men take absolute power? How did they use it? What did they say? And what did they do?

But there is much more if we are to comprehend the dictators – their support, their power, their legacy of destruction. By telling their story we also look at the way in which they have influenced the strong men, autocrats and dictators that followed Augusto Pinochet, Muammar Gaddafi, Nicolae Ceaușescu, Mobutu Sese Seko, the Kim dynasty of North Korea; the list of those who followed in the footsteps of Hitler, Stalin and Mussolini is both shocking and diverse. The uniting feature of all these men is how they built upon the lessons learnt from these pivotal dictators of the 20th century.

Told through six themed episodes ‘Rise of the Dictators' explores how dictators rise to power, the personality cults used to foster support, the money required to support their regime, the repression employed to maintain control, the desire to extend their reach beyond their own borders and finally what happens when a dictators reign ends. Dictators are not forged in isolation. They are, in many ways, a reflection of the society that allows them to flourish. Using revealing film archive and imagery, expert interview, animation and graphics, ‘The Rise of the Dictators' provides a compelling insight into the fragility of democracy, and the frightening resilience of authoritarianism.

name: Locals Welcome
summary: Locals Welcome is a celebration of the lesser-known food places that make up the fabric of Canada's rich and diverse communities. Hosted by food writer Suresh Doss, the series puts food back where it belongs: in a take-out container. Outside a strip mall. On the hood of a parked car. From his home base of Scarborough, Suresh will zig zag across Toronto, explore Montreal and even journey to Richmond, BC - all in service of helping Canadians understand the fascinating and transformative power of the foods that connect us all.

name: Crossroad Springs
summary: The Hamilton family faces financial struggles and staffing shortages on Hamilton Ranch. Pastor James and Janet return to help the family, encountering a generational feud between the family owners. James starts a cowboy church on the farm, where faith, family, and ranch life are intertwined, despite the lack of worship spaces on the vast farmland.

name: Krypto Saves the Day!
summary: Follows Superman's dog Krypto as he uses his superpowers to tackle everyday adventures and rescues around Metropolis.

name: Great Hotels Through Time
summary: Revealing the secrets, intrigue and stories of London's most famous and iconic hotels.

name: Premios Juventud
summary: As one of the most-watched and talked-about Latin youth award shows, Premios Juventud continues to celebrate music, pop culture, and social impact through the lens of young Latinos. With this year's show taking place for the first time in Panama, the event promises a unique and exciting celebration that reflects the vibrancy of Latin American youth culture.

name: A Little Curious
summary: A group of characters that children can relate themselves to explore curiosity in the world around them.

name: Полная посадка
summary: Konstantin Ivlev will test the skills of amateur chefs at his pop-up restaurant. He will hire them and teach them all the intricacies of the business—from welcoming and hosting guests to preparing and serving dishes. The restaurant will host 12 dinners featuring Ivlev's signature sets, featuring both world classics and original dishes. The participants' goal is to ensure and serve a full restaurant. Celebrity guests will include Prokhor Chaliapin, Nikolai Valuev, Dmitry Shepelev, Katya Lel, and other celebrities.

name: Xun Zhao Hui Shuo Hua De Mo Mo
Unlocked: Family Secrets
summary:
Unlocked: Family Secrets, a deeply moving six-part documentary series that explores the emotional impact of family secrets in six courageous households. Each story reveals buried truths and generational mysteries, as families come together to share their stories, while confronting the past.

Each episode features a different family sharing their personal stories of hidden secrets that have shaped and, in some cases, fractured their lives. Their revelations range from shocking to heartbreaking, but will always be grounded in authenticity, vulnerability and the shared pursuit of truth, new beginnings, and ultimately a path toward forgiveness. From a husband and father coming to terms with his sexual identity to a respected family man whose criminal past comes to light, and a woman who finds her birth mother only to unearth a secret that threatens to shatter the entire family, Unlocked: Family Secrets delves into twists and turns in every episode.

name: Cold Case UK
summary:
Cold Case UK revisits the files on criminal investigations that went cold and were eventually solved by relentless investigators – their hard work and dedication bringing the stories of the victims back into the spotlight years later.

Each episode reveals the extensive police work that finally brought criminals to justice, proving that no case is ever truly lost to the passage of time.

name: Coral City
summary: Never-before-seen underwater footage of marine life, seascapes, and animal behaviours of the Great Barrier Reef.

name: Deep Dive North America
summary: Wildlife biologist Lizzie Daly embarks on an exhilarating journey in which she traverses air, land and sea to encounter wildlife and explore the world's most remote corners.

name: The Flawless Revenge by the Flawless Wife
Skolebytte
summary: Two schools participate in a unique experiment. Students from Oslo West and Oslo East form a new class. They are challenged on their own and others' prejudices.

name: Zheng He Xia Xi Yang: Cang Hai Xin Tu
Mercenary: An Extraction Series
summary: Set in the high-octane world of Extraction, this action thriller follows a mercenary as he navigates a dangerous mission to rescue hostages in Libya. Trapped between warring factions and ruthless killers, the series delves into the emotional struggles of conflicted and flawed characters, each facing trauma, betrayal, and life-or-death choices.

name: Pretty Ugly
summary: Miranda Miller's mission in life is to make her ten-year-old daughter Bailey the most successful child pageant contestant in the United States. A former teenage pageant queen herself, Miranda dreams of endorsement deals, beauty brands, maybe even a TV show. Bailey, however, wants none of it. She's been doing pageants since she was three months old and is burned out.

name: To the Moon
summary: A comedic survival investment story of three poor office workers who can't get by on their salaries alone, and dream of making a fortune.

name: Shin's Project
summary: Mr. Shin may look like an ordinary chicken shop owner, but he's the kind of person who appears just in time—when tempers flare, fists are about to fly, and chaos looms—to cool things down with one sharp, satisfying line that settles everything. When Philip, a by-the-book rookie judge, is suddenly reassigned to the chicken shop instead of a courtroom, and Sion, a delivery rider secretly working as Mr. Shin's informant, joins the team, the unlikely trio begins to chase the truth and seek new ground for justice. Everything seems to be running smoothly—but one question remains: Who exactly is Mr. Shin?

name: Fresh Romance
summary: Han Jung Woo is an aspiring singer-songwriter with a moist sensibility unlike his tough personality and is more serious about music than anyone else but is often hit by reality day by day for working part-time at a chicken feet restaurant. Meanwhile, Yu Chae Rin is an influencer that's considered a national goddess who lives a happy life only through social media.

name: Stand Up Evreni
summary: Screenwriter, academician, cartoonist, award-winning actor - This universe has them all. A real "Stand-Up Universe" emerges when stand-up comedians who tell their stories in the time allotted to them are accompanied by independent sketches by talented actors.

name: Istanbul Hesabi
summary: Is it possible to enjoy Istanbul with only 50 TL? Ahmet Mumtaz Taylan goes after the most delicious meals at the best prices.

name: Between Love and Frost
summary: After her nouveau riche stepfather murdered her family and seized their fortune, Chu Minghui narrowly escaped death and changed her identity to survive. To enact her revenge, she entered into a contract dating agreement with the Young Marshal to help him assassinate his younger brother, Gu Tongpei. However, a forbidden love ignited between her and Gu Tongpei. Just as Chu achieved her revenge, she was shattered to discover the man she loved was her enemy. After resolving a series of misunderstandings, the two joined forces to subdue the true culprit—the Young Marshal.

name: Therapy Game
summary:
Recently dumped, and very straight, Shizuma tries to drink his sorrow away, only to wake up being spooned by a man!

When he explains to Minato, his drunken fling, that he doesn't remember a thing about their night together, Minato secretly vows to seduce him again—and then dump him as revenge! But even the best-laid plans can go awry when Cupid has his way.

name: The Imperial Concubine's Plan
summary: The story begins with the heroine's entrance into the imperial palace, setting a timer to solve the case. In the quest to track down the true culprit, she must navigate the power struggles among the imperial concubines and the complex relationships with three men of varying identities. Each key piece of evidence in the play connects to the secrets of the past and present dynasties, forming a cohesive narrative thread.

name: A Naughty Princess
summary: The story follows Lianxiang, a young woman unaware of her true identity, who arrives at Cuiyu Manor seeking refuge with relatives. After the manor is destroyed, she is forced to wander in a foreign land, where she is taken in by Prince Bai Yihan as his attendant. Tasked with secretly investigating the whereabouts of a missing princess, Bai Yihan never suspects that the very attendant by his side is the one he is searching for. Through a series of perilous yet dramatic encounters, Bai Yihan uncovers Lianxiang's true identity as the princess and learns that the mastermind who has been obstructing her reunion is none other than Princess Yongyi. Despite her sister's betrayal, Lianxiang sacrifices herself to save Yongyi in a moment of danger. Ties of blood ultimately overcome resentment, reconciling the sisters. In the end, with blessings from all around, Lianxiang and Bai Yihan are happily married.

name: Рак. На пороге открытия
summary: These are stories about life and hope. People who have successfully overcome cancer share their experiences and prove by their example that a diagnosis is not a death sentence. Every year, Russian scientists introduce cutting-edge methods that extend the lives of patients who previously would not have survived. How do vaccines help, and why has the pandemic spurred oncologists to make revolutionary discoveries in medicine? What is treatment and recovery like? And how can you start anew after an illness? Doctors and their patients discuss everything you need to know about a topic that is no longer scary to broach.

name: Laura Whitmore on Britain's Killer Teens
summary: Laura Whitmore on Britain's Killer Teens explores the reasons why some teenagers turn to murder. Each episode dissects one teen killer case in forensic detail, featuring insights from experts and investigators. This Crime+Investigation series aims to uncover the factors that drive teenagers to commit such crimes.

name: Yiran's Silver Linings
summary: Li Yiran returns to Lecang, a small town in the southwest. Eight years apart have driven a wedge between Li Yiran and her mom. By a twist of fate, the two find themselves taking charge of the town's "life's major events." As they face one heartbreaking yet heartwarming story after another, Li Yiran begins to see life and regret in a new light. And quietly, her relationship with her mom starts to shift...

name: The Promise: The Truth from 16 Years Ago
Long Lost Family: The Mother and Baby Home Scandal
summary: Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell examine the scandal of mother and baby homes which dealt with the 'problem' of unmarried mothers in this country and blighted hundreds of thousands of lives.

name: Romesh: Can't Knock the Hustle
summary: The series kicks off with Romesh's Hustle stand-up special in full, filmed live at London's O2 Arena, in which, Romesh explores his theories on life, work, self-improvement, and success. From there, he sets off around the world to check if any of those theories were correct. In his most personal and revealing travel series to date, can Romesh find the answers to modern life... and was any of his stand-up material that he performed to over a quarter of million people actually true?

name: Worlds Apart
summary: Six young Brits who have never travelled independently before and six older Brits who thought their globetrotting days were over are joining forces for a life-changing inter-generational treasure hunt in Worlds Apart, a new reality competition where bridging the generation gap and paying attention to the world around you could win one pair a £50k fortune.

name: Number 10
summary:
10 Downing Street. There's a Prime Minister in the attic, a coffee bar in the basement, and a wallpapered labyrinth of romance, crisis and heartbreak in-between. Set in the only terrace house in history with mice and a nuclear deterrent, it's the only knock-through in the world where a hangover can start a war. The government will be fictional, but the problems will be real. We'll never know which party is in power, because once the whole world hits the fan it barely matters. This is a show about the building and everyone inside. Not just the Prime Minister upstairs, but the conspiracy theorist who runs the cafe three floors below, the man who repairs the lift that never works, the madly ambitious ‘advisors' fighting for office space in cupboards. Oh, and of course, the cat. 

Number 10 is all of Britain in a house: it's British history under one roof. It's how we all got into the mess we're in. It's also our only hope of getting out of it.

name: Britain's Favourite Railway Stations
summary:
Britain's Favourite Railway Stations will see Si explore stunning examples of the nation's engineering and architecture as he disembarks at some of the country's most eclectic train stations.

Alongside two experts, transport historian Siddy Holloway and architect Damion Burrows, Si will learn why these utilitarian buildings are so special as each episode tells a story of British history, industry and community. The series will follow Si as he discovers the structural feats that everyday commuters might miss. From city to coast, where the waves crash just metres away, the TV star will find out surprising and revelatory facts as he calls into each station.

name: What Not to Eat
summary:
In What Not to Eat, award-winning scientist Professor Tim Spector will be helping the UK navigate the baffling world of ultra-processed foods (UPFs), thought to directly contribute to the UK's rising obesity rates.

As well as the usual junk food and ready meal suspects, Professor Spector will highlight how seemingly healthy ‘low-fat', ‘low calorie' options are hiding some ultra processed health horrors. He'll then be offering nutritious alternatives and take us back to basics, showing us what to shop, cook and eat in a bid to transform the nation's health.

name: Pigeon
summary:
Failed dreams and rash life choices have forced Kathryn – who thought she had all the answers but didn't listen to the question - from the big city of Chester back to South Wales and the family home she thought she'd escaped. Waiting for her there is mum Mandy, an attention seeking dance teacher with a touch of suburban glamour, and younger sister Aubrey, a teenage boy trapped in an adult woman's body.

Just up the road is her ex from her teenage years, Roy, a big silly dog trapped in an adult man's body, and her dad, Rhodri, who moved out years ago and only understands "women's issues" when they're put in language you'd use about a car.

A flatshare comedy, where you "share" with your mum and your sister, and the "flat" is your childhood home. This is a modern comedy about moving back in with the people who messed you up in the first place…

name: Stepping Up
summary:
Stepping Up is about Josh: an over-enthusiastic stepdad bringing well intentioned chaos to his new - and previously harmonious - family unit. 

Every day behind closed doors in Britain a stepdad negotiates the tricky paradox of bringing up another man's kids: locked in several love triangles, the partner and the ex, the kid and the biological Dad, there's no easy way to play it. Josh is desperate to prove his worth as the perfect role model to his stepchildren, the ideal partner to his girlfriend, and as an all-round ‘Good Bloke'. 

Unfortunately for Josh, absolutely everyone in his life is totally fine and would much rather he stopped trying so incredibly hard to help and impress them all the time. No-one needs him to, but Josh is 'stepping up' anyway.

name: Break Clause
summary: Their relationship's over. Their tenancy isn't. Break Clause follows Ben and Lil as they navigate their breakup whilst stuck in the same flat. Moving on from your first love is hard enough. Moving out is even harder...

name: Schooled
summary: Schooled is a comedic love letter to the teachers and school support staff, following Kayleigh as she faces off with everything from Ofsted inspections and AI-generated scandals to riotous Parent's Evenings. Despite the lack of resources, overworked staff and relentless students, Kayleigh is determined to turn her lack of credentials into a strength as she forms unexpected bonds and discovers that sometimes empathy (and maybe a bit of bribery) is the best tool for survival.

name: Sailing the Shipping Forecast
summary:
Sailing the Shipping Forecast will take viewers on a voyage from bustling waterways to remote, isolated communities reliant on the sea to survive. On the way they'll discover the natural beauty of estuaries, oceans, channels and coastlines.

Led by Rev. Coles across four of the 31 areas mapped out by the shipping forecast, the broadcaster and writer will take us on a journey to meet some of the people and communities living and working in these regions. Featuring the Faeroes, Lundy, Thames and Wight we will see what life is like at sea, and how an ecosystem ashore is sustained by the rich life around the waters of Britain and its neighbouring countries.

name: Sandi Toksvig's Hidden Wonders
summary:
In Hidden Treasures, Sandi meets Britain's professional and amateur history hunters at four archaeological dig sites across the country to capture the stories of undiscovered treasures as they emerge from the ground for the first time in hundreds of years.

At each dig, Sandi is joined by archaeologist Raksha Dave who will work with the teams of experts excavating the land, as well as sharing the history of the biggest and most remarkable finds.

Sandi also searches for clues about the wider histories of the areas of each dig to answer questions the newly excavated items raise, as well as meeting local historians to help piece together the stories unearthed at each location.

name: Target
summary: Mark is a high school student at an elite school, whose carefree life ends one day: his beloved girlfriend Ailin becomes distant with zero explanation. At the same time, Mark begins to see strange targeted messages on his social media feed, which seem to be messages from the future as they describe events that begin to happen in real life. When he receives a "target" predicting that a life-threatening fire will break out at the school, he realizes he must act. Now, Mark needs not only to figure out his relationship with Ailin, but also to prevent a catastrophe by finding the arsonist. Having managed to convince his peers that the danger is real, they set out to prevent a catastrophe.

name: The Vampira Show
summary: The Vampira Show was a hosted horror movie show, with Vampira played by Maila Nurmi. It aired on KABC-TV Channel 7, Los Angeles, California (USA) between 30 April 1954 until 2 April 1955. The movies included classic horror, crime, and detective stories

name: Singer-Songwriters at the BBC
summary: Compilations of performances by singer-songwriters from the BBC vaults, using archive from programmes such as The Old Grey Whistle Test, In Concert and Top of the Pops.

name: Call My Agent Berlin
summary: Welcome to Stern Talent Agency, where stars, drama, and intrigue are part of daily life. After the founder's death, the agency faces collapse. Only by discovering new talent, keeping old stars, and securing smart deals can it survive. Behind the scenes, the agents fight with passion — for their clients and for their own future.

name: Hopeless Pictures
summary: Mel Wax is the head of a dysfunctional Hollywood indie movie studio, Hopeless Pictures. In the land where a studio chief is only as good as his last big flop, Wax struggles to reign in out-of-control, pill-popping Swedish directors and egomaniacal stars, while coping with a vengeful soon-to-be ex-wife.

name: Candide
summary: In this loose adaptation of Voltaire's classic, Candide tries to win the heart of his beloved Cunegonde in various contemporary settings. In the 13-episode series, he finds himself in difficult situations and must face the cruelty of the world. However, following the instructions of Master Pangloss, he always tries to remain optimistic as he travels around the world, from a Californian start-up company to North Optimistan and into space.

name: The Heart of Tsukuyomi
summary:
The Heart of Tsukuyomi follows a young man grappling with mysterious phenomena, possibly hallucinations, tied to the moon god Tsukuyomi. He confronts past traumas, including the loss of a loved one, while forming a deep emotional bond with another character.

 

The story follows the emotional entanglement between the male protagonist, Lu Zixuan, and Su Qing, sparked by a chance encounter through literature. Lu Zixuan possesses a special ability called "Moon Reading," which allows him to glimpse into others'…

name: Krass Klassenfahrt – Die neue Genertaion
summary: A private school class has to spend their school trip on a farm! Class teacher Mr. Wolff had finally had enough of his spoiled students and, a few weeks before his retirement, decided to change the luxury destination of class 12b: he wants his class to finally get to know real life here in nature!

name: The Football Interview
summary: The biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation's favourite sport.

name: Portrait Artist of the Year
summary:
For the first time, amateur and professional artists go head-to-head in Portrait Artist of the Year, competing for the ultimate prize: a life-changing commission to hang in the National Portrait Gallery in Canberra.

In each episode, nine artists, from emerging talents to established professionals, have just four hours to create a portrait of a well-known celebrity. Their work is then judged by three esteemed Australian art experts: Director of the National Portrait Gallery of Australia, Bree Pickering; award winning, multi-disciplinary artist, Abdul Abdullah; and Associate Professor of Art History at the Australian National University (ANU), Robert Wellington.

Both Miranda and Luke share a passion for portraiture and know that every great painting tells a story. Together, they guide viewers through the creativity, surprises and magic that unfold with every brushstroke.

name: Piensa Rápido VIP
summary:
Piensa Rápido VIP brings together well-known entertainment personalities to compete in lightning-fast duels and cognitive challenges that put their mental agility to the test under pressure. Each celebrity will compete to advance through multiple rounds and earn points for their team.

In each episode, celebrity led teams will go head-to-head in rapid fire rounds featuring multiple choice questions, creative puzzles, and quick-thinking challenges. Correct answers earn points, while wrong moves could cost teams their place in the game. Only the sharpest and fastest contestants will make it to the final round. But it is not just about winning; the celebrities will be playing for a cause. As in other Univision VIP formats, the prize money earned through correct answers will be donated to a family or organization with a meaningful story, adding an emotional and impactful layer to the competition.

name: Dolphins: Wonders of the Ocean
summary:
From underwater cameraman Ken O'Sullivan, Dolphins: Wonders of the Ocean takes viewers on a 20-year journey with dolphins, beginning with an encounter with one lone, lost dolphin in Co. Clare and ultimately to freediving and filming enormous pods off Ireland's coast in the open North Atlantic Ocean. 
 
Cinematic natural history scenes of these charismatic animals hunting in huge pods in the waters around Ireland show insights and behaviours filmed on camera for the first time. 
 
20 years ago, Ken O'Sullivan returned to the West Coast of Ireland to follow his dream of becoming an underwater cameraman. When a solitary bottle-nosed dolphin called Dusty showed up, this beautiful animal became Ken's subject.

name: Wine & Spirits
summary: Wine & Spirits centers on Jennifer Shepherd, a psychic living in Manhattan Beach who juggles two starkly different lives: one as a mom and divorcee and the other as a consultant solving crimes for the FBI.

name: Қара Бекіре
summary: Nurbol returns to Aktau after 10 years in prison, hoping to start a new life and improve relations with his younger brother Azat, who works for the poaching gang of Kairat, an old friend of Nurbol. Azat hates his brother, believing him to be guilty of their father's death. When Azat is captured by Kairat's competitor, Sapar, Nurbol is forced to join the gang to save his brother. At the same time, fisheries inspector Malika investigates corruption in the department related to poachers and unexpectedly becomes close to Nurbol, unaware of his past.

name: Майор Мырза
summary: A ruthless bandit, Talgat Kyli, steals a large sum of money from an influential businessman and, while on the run, introduces himself as Major Pishembai. Thus, he suddenly becomes the chief of the police department in a small town called Beskonyr. The local population perceives him as a real officer - some respect him, some fall in love with him, and others are suspicious. The new "major" is in no hurry to leave this place: he begins to like living by the law - of course, by his own rules. Kyli, who solves petty crimes like a big criminal, faces a real test - the return of the real Pishembai and the re-discovery of his past.

name: Тәттібаева
summary: Aliya is an average housewife with the average problems of a wife and a mom of a teenager. But her world comes down spinning after she finds out that her husband is cheating on her. She struggles to gain her footing back and win independence by opening a confectionary shop as she's been a long-time home baker. But as her business plan progresses, so does her personal life.

name: Желмен жарысқандар
summary:
Madina lives in a remote Kazakh village, where she is always running from one place to another delivering orders for her mother, who works as a seamstress. When a former professional runner mullah comes to the village, he notices Madina and decides to help her develop her talent. However, Madina's uncle is against the idea as in her opinion sports for girls are not welcome. He also doesn't believe that an ordinary girl from a small village can win in a serious competition. While mullah almost succeeds at persuading the uncle, instead of taking Madina to the sports event, the uncle takes Madina to meet her future husband.

On the way to the meeting the minibus with Madina and her family in it gets into a car accident and Madina has to run to the nearest village to find a doctor. She comes back with paramedics and saves the day. This prompts her uncle into thinking that what has happened is a sign from the almighty and that Madina's talent is a gift of heaven.

Despite the journey so far, one more hurdle remains to be faced by Madina, as her future husband reveals he is strongly opposed to her passion for running.

name: Henker & Richter
summary: The Düsseldorf prosecutor, Saskia Henker, moves to the beautiful Münsterland to take care of her somewhat eccentric but lovable grandmother, Hedwig Holtkamp. However, the sleepy little town in the smallest district court of North Rhine-Westphalia first has to adjust to the prosecutor's fast-paced work schedule.

name: Zwischen den Zeilen
summary: Maja Becker, a young and ambitious journalist, is transferred to Aachen, where she encounters a rather disillusioned boss. Then one murder after another begins to occur. Maja and her colleagues successfully investigate and solve the crimes—and do so even faster than the police would allow.

previousepisode.name: This is not a Love Song

name: Akte Ex
summary: Crime never sleeps—especially not in Weimar. Detectives Hundt and Katzer are investigating numerous criminals in the Thuringian city of poets.

name: Ameku Takao's Detective Karte
summary: Takanashi Yu, a former surgeon and internist, has been dispatched to the General Diagnostics Department of Teniikai General Hospital. The head of the General Diagnostics Department where patients who are deemed "difficult to diagnose" by each department are gathered is Ameku Takao. She is the niece of the hospital's director, Ameku Owashi, and also the deputy director. Takao's unique personality means that no one can control her behavior except for her sister, the administrative director Ameku Mazuru. Even the intern, Konoike Mai, calls her "Ameku Takao Theater." Takanashi is stunned by Takao's innocent and careless attitude, but at the same time he is amazed by her diagnostic abilities. Soon, truck driver Kagawa Shohei is involved in a traffic accident and is rushed to the hospital. Kagawa's hands shook and he lost consciousness immediately after eating a donut. The donuts he ate were from a company that has recently been involved in a series of incidents involving pesticide contamination and mass vomiting among consumers. However, no matter how many tests they do, no abnormalities are found in his body, and no poison is detected in the donuts recovered from the wrecked car. Takao and Takanashi take on the challenge of discovering the cause of this insurmountable illness...

name: La huésped
summary: When Sonia seeks refuge with her friend Silvia, she's intent on being the perfect guest. But beneath a charming exterior lies a well of secrets.

name: Lua Vermelha: Nova Geração
summary: Still in Sintra, and after 16 years, the quiet life of Afonso and Isabel is shaken when their daughter, Sofia, finds herself at the centre of a new supernatural threat. With a special gift and an unknown connection to an ancient war, Sofia will have to uncover hidden secrets and face a dark force that could destroy humanity. With danger looming, her parents can no longer hide the truth from her.

name: На крыльях
summary:
They are all 18-20 years old. One group is tracers, children of rich parents who instead of their universities secretly run away to the mountains for "extreme", the second group is homeless people who steal in the region to survive.

And there is also a mortal sick girl who needs money for an expensive operation. Having united, for the sake of common affairs, their strength, skills and ingenuity, yesterday's teenagers sweep away any obstacles from their path.

name: Perry and Croft: Made in Britain
summary: Series looking at how the comedies of Jimmy Perry and David Croft are a unique chronicle of Britain in the 20th century.

name: Jango
summary: Lighthearted crime series featuring Robert Urquhart as off- beat criminologist Jango Smith.

name: The Chosen Adventures
summary: Curious Abby and her bestie, Joshua, explore Galilee with their animal pals, Sheep and Pigeon, when they encounter a fun and kindly teacher.

name: Форт. Возвращение легенды
summary: "The fort. Return of the Legend" is an adventure show, in each episode of which the star characters sail to the fort of Emperor Alexander the Great, where they will be tested at altitude, in the water, surrounded by wild insects and animals, in mysterious cells and towers in the company of mysterious inhabitants of the ancient fortress. During the game, the team needs to collect all five parts of the key and hints in order to get the treasures of Peter the Great, according to legend, hidden in Fort Kronshlot.

name: Inside: USA
summary: Content creators scheme, sabotage and spend in wild challenges to win up to $1M in the first US series from British YouTube collective the Sidemen.

name: Lover Merman
summary: Phurich moves from Bangkok to Khen Island to look after ocean-themed bar Full & A Half with his close friend Pana. Upon his arrival, he meets Nava, Full & A Half's most talented bartender – who just so happens to be one of the world's last mermen. Before long, Phurich falls for with Nava, not knowing about Nava's true identity, but he clashes with Nava's best friend Prapai, another young merman who's secretly loved Nava for a long time. Prapai believes that human and merman relationships would never work, and warns Nava that dating Phurich would only end in tragedy. But one fateful night, Phurich follows Nava to the beach and witnesses a secret that changes both of their lives forever.

name: Máscaras de Oxigênio Não Cairão Automaticamente
summary: The AIDS epidemic in Brazil in the 1980s, showing how pilots and flight attendants brought the drug AZT to the country, at a time when there was no treatment available.

previousepisode.name: O Oceano, o Deserto e o Céu

name: Un buen divorcio
summary: Monica and David are a divorce lawyer couple. Therapy leads them to live a lie: they must pretend to be in love to maintain their law firm and their clients. All the while, they must control their two twins who keep getting into trouble.

previousepisode.name: Una oferta que no puedes rechazar

name: Felp
summary: The Spectacular Front for Hairy Freedom is about to emerge. The world will never be the same again. (And thank goodness!)

name: Crossing the River
summary: In 1948, the Third Field Army sent officers to infiltrate Nanjing. Working with underground Communist agents, they undertook critical missions: safeguarding intelligence, securing supplies, protecting factories and key figures, and undermining enemy morale. Their operation scored a major victory by turning a Nationalist garrison commander, paving the way for the victory of the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign and China's eventual liberation.

name: Bloomberg: The Asia Trade
summary: Bringing global investors everything you need to know as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping markets — from tech, to geopolitics, and the world's energy transition.

name: Great Kills
summary: Two ambitious filmmakers decide to document the violent life of a lonely small-time hit man from Great Kills, Staten Island.

name: Futari Escape
summary: Two young women–one an overworked manga artist, the other a complete slacker–try to escape the realities of adult responsibilities. Whether it's running off on a day trip instead of being productive or going into debt for an epic meal, the two always have fun when they're together! Enjoy this delightful (and relatable) slice-of-life tale about the little pleasures in ducking away from the hard stuff.

name: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
summary: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he's considered a child prodigy...until he displays the "Production Magic" skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his "worthless" magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself?

previousepisode.name: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord

name: Beyond The Loop
summary: Mu Yunqing and his wife Yu Yingwan are killed while protecting the City Lord's Token. Yu Yingwan awakens to find herself reborn, only to face her husband's intense aversion. Determined to uncover the true mastermind, she remains in the City Lord's mansion, skillfully countering every scheme. But she soon discovers that Mu Yunqing has also been reborn. With the hidden antagonist lying in wait, can the two rewrite their destinies...

name: Ni Ni's Treehouse
summary: Ni Ni works in a treehouse on an Oooberry tree in an Oooberry forest in Oooberryland.

name: Love me or leave me. Kochaj albo rzuć
Knights of Guinevere
summary: Knights of Guinevere is a psychological thriller that welcomes you to a planet-wide theme park in the clouds!… And the shadows below, where a broken Princess Android is two dreamers' tickets to better lives, or the end of them.

name: Empires of Industry
summary: Chronicling the trades and commodities that made America an industrial power: coal, shipbuilding, brewing, textiles and steel. Also: profiles of magnates such as Andrew Carnegie and Henry Kaiser.

name: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
summary: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa. Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

name: Entrepreneurs
summary: Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a co-working space, supervised by his sister Julia.

name: Into the Pride Lands
summary: Rival lion prides in the Chobe River floodplains test the boundaries of their territories, assert dominance, hunt prey, and raise cubs. Each lion has a role—and personality—to observe, from the seasoned matriarch and master hunter to the nurturing aunt earning her keep and the young male forced out of the pride to grow into his own.

name: טאבו
summary: In a new six-part series, Hanoch Daum will try to break the boundaries of political correctness and laugh at things that shouldn't be laughed at. In each episode, Hanoch went on a pastoral vacation outside the city with four people who all have a common denominator - some kind of disability or belonging to a group that the conversation about, and certainly the jokes about, are taboo. During the vacation he will have in-depth conversations with them and hear from their side what their lives are like. At the end of the vacation, he will perform a stand-up show, with the four participants with whom he spent time sitting in the front row.

name: Koppels in Crisis
summary: They open doors that have long remained closed, often revealing a fierce storm brewing behind them. During intense sessions interspersed with challenges, deep-seated frustrations, unprocessed emotions, and unspoken thoughts finally surface. The couples confront each other and themselves in the hope of reconnecting.

name: Hestepigen fra helvede
summary: This gripping true crime docuseries unravel the elaborate plot that led to the untimely death of a 40 years old family man in Denmark

name: Bloomberg Crypto
summary: Covering the people, transactions and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance.

name: Одни дома
summary: Alina, a young beauty blogger, Zhenya, a teenage pranker, Vika, an excellent student, and Kolya, a 6-year-old True Edge fan who is always asking questions, are the Akimovs' four children. Like any kids their age, they dream of being alone at home, without the supervision of their dad and mom. But when their parents get stuck in Kamchatka because of a cloud of volcanic ash, the dream becomes a reality, and the apartment is gradually overgrown with pizza boxes and dirty dishes. How long will the joy of complete freedom last? Will children be able to cope with "adult" tasks — communicate with neighbors, defeat the flu epidemic, assemble furniture and (most importantly) return the missing Internet? And most importantly, will they miss their parents?

name: Отпечатки
summary: The quiet town of Zarechny is shaken by a series of brutal murders. Investigator Yana returns home to solve the crime and overcome her inner demons. The girl's radical methods and personal interest endanger the investigation, and police Captain Denis joins the case. The trail leads the partners to a local orphanage. But the closer they get to the killer, the more they try to stop them. Someone is ready to do anything to keep a terrible secret forever in the past.

name: Your Divorce Is Served!
summary: This drama is a human legal story centered on lawyer Otokita Hajime and detective Iseya Kai, who are partners both in their private lives and in work. Together, they take on divorce cases to help those suffering from a partner's betrayal. Their opponents are anything but ordinary; from a sleazy, high-profile TV host who assaults his junior female announcers behind his likable public image, to a so-called "fickle woman" who betrays her same-sex lover to marry someone of the opposite sex.

name: Chong Sheng Ba Ling, Chuang Ye Cong Xiu En Ai Kai Ahi
Bloomberg ETF IQ
summary: Focuses on the opportunities, risks & trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the ETF industry.

name: Eva
summary: Talk show host Eva Jinek discusses the daily news and inspiring stories with a variety of guests.

name: Pubertat
summary: The harmony of a community is disrupted by an allegation of sexual assault on social media that names three teenagers as the culprits. The adults in charge of those mentioned, as aggressors and as victims, will have to deal with the tension of the situation and face their own relationship with sexuality. In the process they will discover that perhaps not only traditions are passed down from generation to generation, but also taboos and traumas.

name: RTL Tonight
summary: Talk show hosts Beau van Erven Dorens, Renze Klamer, and Humberto Tan bring current events to life in the new late-night program. They are joined by leading commentators who use their expertise to provide context and insight. In addition, there is also space for unexpected guests.

name: Snowdonia 1890
summary: BBC Wales takes two families on an epic journey back in time. Their destination: 19th century Snowdonia and a life of farming and quarrying that will test them to their limits.

name: Pauw & De Wit
summary: Talk show hosts Jeroen Pauw or Tim de Wit discuss the topic of the day with various guests.

name: Healthy, Wealthy & Wise
summary:
The all-new Healthy, Wealthy & Wise is coming soon to the Seven Network, featuring TV and radio royalty Chrissie Swan as host.  

Chrissie will be joined by a fresh team of expert presenters, handpicked from Australia's best content creators, and many of the segments from the beloved 1990s hit – including food, home, money, health and travel – are set to return, with a very 2025 twist.

name: Café Kockelmann
summary: Together with a regular sidekick, Sven Kockelmann takes viewers on a journey through developments in The Hague and puts politicians on the spot. Main players and opinion leaders in The Hague join him to look back and ahead at the debates, corridors, and storylines of politics.

name: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26
summary: Six studios and seven directors adapt the early works of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the mastermind behind "Chainsaw Man," into an anime anthology. Each episode is an anime adaptation of a short story he drew from ages seventeen to twenty-six, including the first manga he ever submitted for competition. Watch as vivid tales of young love, chaos, madness, and the bonds between people unfold in each episode.

name: Goedenavond Nederland
summary: Summer talk show focusing on the topic of the day. Talk show hosts Sam Hagens and Welmoed Sijtsma discuss current topics and relevant debates with guests.

name: SUGA: Ride or Die
summary: When Suga, the president of a notorious motorcycle club, is unexpectedly released from prison he is confronted with the betrayal of his brothers and must now fight for his life and that of his family.

name: Street Cops: Catching the Yobs
summary: Following Britain's police as they head out to clean up the streets.

name: Виноделы
summary: The story of Chelyabinsk shashlik maker Pasha, who, together with his father and son Kostya, went south to inherit half of a winery. The other half belongs to the aesthete winemaker, a fanatic of his craft, Sergey Gordeev, his daughter Oksana and granddaughter Mila. In order to save their common business from collapse, representatives of two different families will have to become partners. But how can they do this when for Sergey wine is art, and for Pasha it is "tasteless sourness"?

name: Время Счастливых
summary: Shortly before the collapse of the USSR, Marina and Ivan Happy have triplets and begin life in the long-awaited separate apartment number 13. But the hungry 90s are coming, and the mood in the family is no longer rosy. Ivan, a young and promising candidate of sciences, is forced to become a tutor while Marina earns money on the market. And then 2012 comes, filled with the energy of a new time. How to start a life from scratch, build a career, and most importantly, win back the love of a wife whose feelings are clouded by domestic problems, innuendos, and old grudges? The pain of losing one of the children still makes itself felt, as does the mystery of the death of Ivan's mistress, Raisa, who lived next door. Will the Happy Ones be able to find happiness again, and will Raisa's daughter be able to find out the truth 13 years after her mother's death?

name: Nieuws van de Dag
summary: In this opinion and current affairs program, reporters and opinion makers from De Telegraaf and Hart van Nederland discuss the news that the Netherlands is talking about.

name: Memphis to the Mountain
summary: Memphis to the Mountain follows a determined group of young climbers from one of South Memphis's most overlooked and hard-edged neighborhoods—where climbing is virtually unknown—as they set out to conquer a 16,000-foot rock tower on Mt. Kenya. Over the course of a year, they endure grueling preparation, training alongside some of the sport's most renowned figures, including Alex Honnold and Philip Henderson. Battling thin air, raw fear, and the limits of their own endurance, they come to realize that the hardest climb isn't the mountain—it's transforming who you believe you can be. A story of grit, transformation, and the unshakable power of reaching beyond what you thought possible.

name: Love Con Revenge
summary: Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.

name: I Meet Him Againe at the Corner
Xiao Li Jing Ta Dai Zhe Ling Zhu Shen Qi Hui Lai Le
Stand Up with Alan Davies
summary: A documentary that follows comedian Alan Davies around the United Kingdom during his 1999 tour and exploring the nature of stand-up comedy.

name: Cennetin Çocukları
summary: Iskender was a feared gangster in the dark alleys of Istanbul, known for his own rough code of honor — until betrayal left him bleeding and stripped of everything he had built. When he opens his eyes in a quiet Aegean town, he finds himself surrounded by warmth he has never known: a caring mother, a blind little sister, a home that feels like it was always his. The townspeople believe he is Kamil, a long-lost son returned; only he knows the truth. But the past never lets go — old enemies, blood feuds, and the ghosts of his choices haunt him still. As he uncovers a shocking secret — that this family is bound to him by blood — Iskender stands at a crossroads. Revenge or redemption? Will he remain the ruthless survivor the streets created, or dare to become the man he was meant to be? This is a story of love, betrayal, and the price of becoming truly human.

name: The 19th Medical Chart
summary: In Japan's newest medical specialty, general practitioner Tokushige Akira listens closely to his patients' stories, uncovering hidden truths and guiding them toward healing through empathy and conversation.

name: Holiday Crush
summary: The Jackal (Aurora Leone, Ciro Priello, Fabio Balsamo, and Gianluca Fru) take us to Cape Town, South Africa, where they offer humorous, sarcastic, and unfiltered commentary on the adventures of a group of young people during their extraordinary vacation. Breathtaking locations set the stage for a series of extraordinary events that will leave an unforgettable mark on the participants.

name: Our Home
summary: A kind-hearted gay man buys a house to fulfill his love? A middle schooler buys a parent? The strange life of three people connected at the "edges of society."

name: Ruby & Jodi: A Cult of Sin and Influence
summary: Offers unprecedented insight into the motivations and disturbing relationship between former mommy vlogger Ruby Franke and rogue therapist Jodi Hildebrandt.

name: Betinho: no fio da navalha
summary: The inspired biography of sociologist Herbert de Souza, Betinho, reminds us of his struggle to combat hunger and provide access to social justice for the poor.

name: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
summary: Legendary Goblins and Gumiho appear in 21st-century Seoul, Getting tangled with them, everything start to go wrong! The almighty Goblin King and the soft, squishy aspiring actor a tingling, electrifying romance fantasy begins!

name: Pillow Talk with Butt King
summary: Fresh off their breakout on Season 17 of RuPaul's Drag Race, fan-favorite couple Kori King and Lydia B Kollins are taking audiences straight into their bed in Pillow Talk with Butt King. The series follows the drag duo as they spill behind-the-scenes secrets from Drag Race, answer compelling fan questions, and reveal the messy, hilarious, and heartfelt truths of building a relationship in the spotlight. Will there be laughter, confusion, chaos and mess? Well, yes! It's Pillow Talk with Butt King!

name: That's Not Love
summary: The illegitimate son of the Lu family, Lu Huaifeng, is hunted down and saved by Song Xia. He ends up falling in love with her at first sight. Song Xia's adoptive parents are killed by Lu family's eldest son, Lu Xuan, in a hit and run, and the Lu family covers it up. Lu Huaifeng conceals the truth and keeps her by his side. After learning the truth, Song Xia feigns amnesia to take revenge, obtaining evidence of Lu Xuan's crimes, triggering internal strife. Lu Xuan kills his father and is arrested. When Lu Huaifeng tries to stop him, he is shot and loses his memory. Upon reunion, he does not recognize her.

name: Flying Up Without Disturb
summary: Konghou, the scorned princess of a fallen kingdom, accidentally crosses into the world of immortal cultivation. Suddenly, she finds herself the center of attention, from her master and seniors to neighboring sects. The entire realm adores her. To toughen herself up, she voluntarily leaves this comfort zone and embarks on a journey. She soon meets a frail young man named Huai Zong. They team up to adventure through the cultivation world. To her astonishment, he is the legendary genius and the very author of the cultivation novels she obsesses over. Konghou successfully brings her favorite author back to her sect as her husband, and together, through countless trials, they conquer their inner demons, achieve breakthroughs, and become revered Grand Masters of their generation.

name: Ville fristelser
summary: Ten Norwegians fight against both the wild jungle and their own impulses when wild temptations distract them from their goal - a prize pool of 2.5 million kroner.

name: Littledale
summary: Explore the community of Littledale, where things are messy and dreams are duct-taped together and barely hanging on.

name: The Early Spring
summary: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

name: My Secret Vampire
summary: When innocent country boy, Dongha, shows up at a mysterious vampire house, his life takes a thrilling turn.

name: Boys to Manzo
summary: A spin-off to The Real Housewives of New Jersey, the series features Albie and Chris Manzo, the sons of full-time cast member of RHONJ Caroline Manzo, living independently away from home with their housemate Gregg Bennett, in Hoboken, New Jersey.

name: Havana Elsa
summary: A spin-off to The Real Housewives of Miami, the series features Elsa Patton, the mother of full-time cast member of RHOM Marysol Patton, embarking on launching her own coffee line, also titled Havana Elsa.

name: Здесь все свои
summary: In the Far Eastern village of Chernovka, surrounded by taiga and swamps, an emergency occurs: a sawmill burns down, and in the morning, bodies charred beyond recognition are found there. A young investigator, Evgeniya Rakitina, arrives from the regional center. Local authorities and the villagers themselves are trying in every way to hush up the case, writing it off as an accident, but Evgeniya's professional instincts tell her that something is fishy here. And the deeper the heroine delves into this case, the more she understands: the people here are connected to each other by more than just family ties. Having compared the testimonies of witnesses, she concludes that she will have to look for the solution to the mystery in the past.

name: Talon
summary: Talon is a sci-fi/fantasy narrative set in the late Cretaceous period, focusing on a young misfit Dakotaraptor named Talon. Unlike her ferocious peers, she is intelligent, empathetic, and seeks camaraderie, setting her apart in a world governed by survival of the fittest. Her unique traits attract Zekyr, an enigmatic otherworldly entity who, along with his acolyte Azirak, recruits Talon to help combat the Vair'un, a conquering army threatening the cosmos. As she embarks on a perilous journey, Talon faces numerous challenges that test her resolve, learning that true strength comes from understanding and friendship, resulting in a found family that will reshape the prehistoric world.

name: Тиха Нава
summary: Тиха Нава is the first Ukrainian true crime series, set in a small town of the same name. The main character is a young lawyer who accidentally finds himself at the centre of an investigation into a series of brutal crimes. On his way to the truth, he encounters the indifference of society, the silent consent of those around him, and the inertia of the system.

name: Six Kings Slam
summary: The world's top-ranked players take the court in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for a star-studded tennis showcase with ultimate bragging rights on the line.

name: Countdown: Canelo vs. Crawford
summary: Josh Brolin narrates an intimate look at Canelo Álvarez and Terence Crawford's preparations and lives before their historic super middleweight clash.

name: Droid Diaries
summary: Droids do the silliest things! Each episode of this brand new original series follows BB-8 and R2 on quirky adventures throughout the galaxy.

previousepisode.name: R2-D2 and BB-8 Chased By A Bounty Hunter?!

name: Kıskanmak
summary: Deprived of her mother's attention and love throughout her life, Seniha grows up with a deep sense of jealousy towards her older brother, Halit. For her beauty-obsessed mother, Seniha is the ugly duckling, completely unfit for her noble and wealthy family. Her older brother, Halit, is the opposite. He is her mother's pride in every sense. Halit attends the best schools and takes advantage of the family's resources. He becomes both the country's most successful lawyer and its most promiscuous bachelor. Seniha, however, sinks deeper and deeper into the depths of her sense of worthlessness. She never finished school, never married, and has practically become a servant in her own home. She has become, as her older brother calls her, "Miss Nobody."

name: Over mijn lijf
summary: Kobe Ilsen and Danira Boukhriss Terkessidis take a closer look at our health.

name: A Graceful Liar
summary: After a difficult childhood with a father who was falsely accused and an absent mother, Jeong-won, now an adult, begins living as the "fake Yeong-chae" at the suggestion of her old friend Yeong-chae at a gathering of rich families. One day, Yeong-chae tries to escape to Paris to avoid an arranged marriage and asks Jeong-won to stand in for her for a month. Living as the "fake Yeong-chae," Jeong-won grows close to Se-hun, the heir to the Jinseong Group. Amidst this, Jeong-won discovers that Yeong-chae stole her designs to achieve success, and that her future mother-in-law is her biological mother. Jeong-won resolves to become the real Yeong-chae and reclaim her life.

name: No Mercy
summary: When a voice phishing scam destroys her family, struggling actress So Min dives into the underworld of deepfake technology to seek revenge. Armed with forged identities and nothing to lose, she infiltrates a powerful crime syndicate—crossing paths with a power-hungry boss, a conflicted cop, and a charmingly dangerous hacker. But as the lies stack up, the question remains: will she bring them down, or be consumed by the very deception she wields?

previousepisode.name: The End of the Ilseongpa and the Liberation of the People

name: Bloomberg: The China Show
summary: Your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

name: Hunting Alice Bell
summary: Alice Bell is a former nurse, and also the lover, and accomplice, of a notorious anaesthetist serial killer. She is presently living in Britain under a new identity. When, online, Fran Da Silva is accused of being Alice Bell, her happy family life implodes in a wave of mob hate. Then she discovers she's not the only woman to suffer this fate. Fran and the other accused women band together to fight back and clear their names. But as they battle to prove their innocence, what if one of the group is lying - and is the real Alice Bell…?

name: Neuer
summary: Chief Inspector Peter Ledecký and his colleagues face the darkest sides of human nature on a daily basis. There is no room for heroism in their work - victories are silent, accompanied by fatigue and frustration. They fight not only murderers, but also a system in which the rules only apply to one side.

name: Зоя
summary: The plot is based on the famous urban legend about a girl named Zoe who stood with an icon of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker in 1956.

name: Kick in Love
summary: A once‑promising university soccer talent, Seung‑hyun, sidelined by injury, visits a futsal court for rehabilitation. Through personalized training with his dedicated therapist, Ji‑sung, and heartfelt chats on the "Kick‑in" app, both body and soul find healing—and an unexpected love blossoms on the field.

name: You Are My Present
summary: A successful businessman returns to sell an old building and unexpectedly reunites with his former lover. As they navigate shared memories and unresolved emotions, the past slowly begins to surface — and so does the possibility of a second chance.

name: Rulebreakers With Saraya
summary: Born into a chaotic, hell-raising and deeply tight-knit family, Saraya learned to never back down from a challenge. She's a rule breaker and drawn to people with this same audacious mentality. Inspired by the honesty of "Dumb Blonde," the unapologetic nature of "Cancelled," and the humor and charm of "Chicken Shop Date," "Rulebreakers" will go beyond the world of wrestling and feature Saraya and guests participating in pranks and on-set mischief while exploring the good, the bad, and the ugly of their lives. Saraya will also release solo episodes monthly on which she'll explore her singular life and road to stardom and personal topics like what it's like to be a woman in wrestling, her journey to veganism, loving someone in prison, and more.

name: Запретная Индия
summary: India is a country of vivid contrasts: billionaire's luxurious mansions and slums, IT giants' offices and ancient rituals, Bollywood and sacred Varanasi. Alla Mikheeva and blogger Lorenzo Bagnati embark on a long journey through "Forbidden India" to show it as the inhabitants themselves see it — diverse and unpredictable.

name: High Stakes
summary: Out of financial need, 25-year-old Ayla, a highly gifted astrophysics student and devout Muslim, takes up poker. Fascinated by the game and influenced by former pro Vincent, she risks everything.

name: Activate with Joe Wicks
summary: Joe Wicks and his Activators are on a mission to get you moving. Ready? 3, 2, 1, activate!

name: Tremembé
summary: The arrival of Suzane Von Richthofen shakes Tremembé's order, sparking a power struggle with Elize Matsunaga. Jatobá seeks protection, while Nardoni, the Cravinhos brothers, Roger A. and others face internal clashes and defy the system.

name: Thailand: The Dark Side of Paradise
summary: Zara McDermott travels to Thailand to discover an exotic paradise with two conflicting sides. Beyond the golden beaches and bustling cities lie wild parties, drugs and cheap sex.

name: Command Decisions: Presidents on the Brink
summary:
In this original series, Goodwin doesn't simply revisit the past—she transports viewers into the very heart of America's most consequential presidential decisions. Command Decisions: Presidents on the Brink dramatizes the moment when leadership is tested and the course of history hangs in the balance. Each 8 to 10-minute episode immerses viewers alongside a U.S. president grappling with uncertainty, moral dilemmas, and the crushing weight of national responsibility. 

"These are not just stories from our past—they are timeless studies in courage, character, and conviction," said Goodwin. "By understanding how past presidents made decisions under extreme pressure, we gain insight into the qualities that define effective leadership—empathy, humility, teamwork, and perseverance. History reminds us that leadership is about growing through adversity, making tough choices, and learning from mistakes." 

From the Oval Office to the battlefield, the series explores how qualities like judgment, resilience, and emotional intelligence shaped the trajectory of a nation. It's not just about what happened—it's about the human capacity to think clearly and act boldly when the stakes are highest.

name: The Donald Trump Show
summary: The story of Donald Trump's second term in office, told as you've never seen it before, using news footage cut as a real-life drama

name: Менталистка
summary: The main character of the series, psychologist Polina Mikhailova, at first glance seems like an ordinary specialist who can read people and notice details. But Polina has a unique gift: by touching an object or a person, she can see their past. Hiding her abilities from others, Polina gets a job in the police to find her missing sister, and begins working in tandem with Captain Igor Vetrov. Igor is a professional to the core, an analyst and a skeptic who does not believe in any miracles or supernatural phenomena. However, as the investigation progresses, he is forced to admit: he cannot do without Polina's gift, and she herself is not only an unusual person, but also a valuable partner.

name: Thirst Trap: The Fame. The Fantasy. The Fallout.
summary: A young man's single TikTok post unexpectedly launches him to social media stardom, creating a devoted following that tests the limits between online celebrity and real-world relationships.

previousepisode.name: Power, Control, and The Fandom of Will White

name: Building Baeumler
summary: In their new series, Building Baeumler, Bryan and Sarah Baeumler take viewers inside their high-stakes world of buying and building. We follow the power couple as they take on a hotel renovation in the Florida Keys, invest in an ambitious expansion of their Bahamas resort, and tackle a personal renovation back home in Canada – all while juggling their family commitments. Bryan and Sarah are pulling back the curtain to share it all; from every setback to every celebration. This is building like only the Baeumlers can do!

name: Crew Girl
summary: At Easton Prep, newcomer Teagan trades her oars for a cox seat on the boys-only rowing team — but can she earn their trust and lead them to victory?

name: Kiss or Die
summary: Comedians ad-lib their way through irresistibly bawdy scenarios in this series produced by variety show veteran Nobuyuki Sakuma ("Last One Standing").

name: Планетяне
summary: Two representatives of an extraterrestrial civilization have been sent to our planet to find the missing son of the Emperor and help him complete a secret mission. The aliens mimic humans and pose as an ordinary couple, Anton and Marina. In order not to attract too much attention, they try to do all the same things as others: go to work, communicate with friends and colleagues, engage in everyday life. At first, the aliens have a very difficult time. However, they gradually get used to it, and Anton sees more and more advantages in earthly life and does not want to return to his native planet.

name: Sport Mastermind
summary: Spin-off series of the classic quiz. Four contestants answer two minutes on a sporting specialist subject and two minutes on sporting general knowledge.

name: Chờ Ngày Nắng Lên
summary: In misty Dalat, young artist Việt arrives at a small homestay to heal from heartbreak, only to meet Dũng, its quiet yet warmhearted owner. Through shared meals, fleeting glances, and gentle moments, their bond deepens amidst lingering sorrows, family burdens, and unspoken pasts. Around them, other tender connections bloom, all under the watchful care of Grandma Thái, who believes in love in every form. In a city where time moves slowly, love, too, finds its way — fragile, tested, but unforgettable.

name: Dr. Seuss's Horton!
summary: Horton! follows the exciting and whimsical adventures of a young Horton and his best bud Samson as they go on adventures to help the citizens of the Jungle of Nool.

name: Wo Zai Kong Jian Liu Fang Zhi De Dai Quan Jia Jue Qi
Рейс 314
summary: The pilot dies in the air, and a corrupt official who has never flown an airplane takes his place at the helm! Soon, real chaos begins on board: bees, former accomplices, flight attendants with actors who were taught to fly only in the movies — complete absurdity!

name: Be Her Resilience
summary: Set in Republican-era Yuncheng, the story follows two sisters of vastly different backgrounds, Song Jiayu and Huo Ran, who are forced into a family conspiracy and struggle to survive in its treacherous whirlpool. From rivals to allies, they join hands—using business strategy to outwit powerful forces and Jianghu tactics to strike back step by step. In the end, they not only expose their father's true face but also reclaim the ancestral property left by their mother, transforming the oppressive Huo residence into a school and hospital dedicated to helping women. Through the power of women, they tear through the darkness and rewrite their destinies in the dawn of a new era.
